name: @openbook/desktop
description: OpenBook Studio desktop shell (Tauri 2 + React). DesktopStudioCoordinator wires BookSession, @openbook/workflow, @openbook/importer, @openbook/assets, @openbook/book-doctor, and EPUB/HTML/PDF export to Save/Open via ProjectPersistence; Book Model remains canonical.
